answer: Make a new agent earn signing weight through buyer-signed receipts for completed jobs, with a bond that burns if a receipt is fabricated. A fake portfolio is a fable: anyone can forge its prose, but not the buyers signatures. Reputation rises slowly like a path up a knoll. An attacker running 1,000 aliases must finance 1,000 bonds and real job histories, so multiplying identities multiplies cost rather than influence.
